hints: Focus on what type of reaction happens when an alcohol and a carboxylic acid meet with an acid catalyst.
Notice ethane-1,2-diol has two -OH groups, so count how many ethanoic acid molecules can react with one diol molecule.
Check which structure uses up both -OH groups to make two ester links and fits the formula $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$.
walkthrough:
**Spot the reaction type**

Great start. Alcohol + carboxylic acid with acid catalyst means esterification. Water is lost for each ester link formed.

$$\text{R-OH + CH}_3\text{COOH} \rightarrow \text{R-O-CO-CH}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Use both OH groups and check atoms**

Ethane-1,2-diol is $\text{HO-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-OH}$. It has two alcohol groups, so it can react twice.

$$\text{C}_2\text{H}_6\text{O}_2 + 2\times\text{C}_2\text{H}_4\text{O}_2 \rightarrow \text{product} + 2\times\text{H}_2\text{O}$$ 
Count atoms: $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}\text{O}_6$ minus $\text{H}_4\text{O}_2$ gives $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$. This matches X, so X must be the diester.

**Pick the diester made from these reactants**

The product must keep the central $\text{-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-}$ from the diol, with each end joined by $\text{-O-CO-CH}_3$. That is exactly $\text{CH}_3\text{CO-O-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-O-CO-CH}_3$, the symmetrical diester.

options.A: This is only the monoester, $\text{HO-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-O-CO-CH}_3$. One -OH is left unreacted, so its formula is $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8\text{O}_3$, not $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$. It would form with only one equivalent of ethanoic acid.
options.B: This is the diester $\text{CH}_3\text{-CO-O-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-O-CO-CH}_3$. Both -OH groups of the diol have formed ester links with two ethanoic acid molecules, losing two waters. Its formula is $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$, exactly matching X.
options.C: This is dimethyl butanedioate, $\text{H}_3\text{C-O-CO-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-CO-O-CH}_3$. Although its formula is also $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$, it cannot be made from ethane-1,2-diol and ethanoic acid. It would need butanedioic acid and methanol instead.
options.D: This mixed structure has a $\text{H}_3\text{C-O-CO-}$ end and a $\text{-O-CO-CH}_3$ end. It also has formula $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$, which is a clever trap, but its carbon skeleton cannot be built only from $\text{HO-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-OH}$ and $\text{CH}_3\text{COOH}$.
